hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition (SM120)
scope: Complete routed-expert GPU pipeline with precomputed routing; no routing selection, shared experts, communication, host enqueue or serving. Synthetic tensors at common model geometry; no checkpoint conversion or serving claim.
timer: CUPTI first-to-last GPU activity span from a single-call CUDA Graph replay; cold flush is outside the span. Warm means repeated identical operands, not guaranteed L2 residency.
baseline: Flat cutlass_fused_moe FP16; on SM120 this uses the SM80-family native implementation. All 8 x 8 advertised GEMM1/GEMM2 pairs plus default were attempted; 16 pairs require unsupported shared memory. Not a claim over every library.
selection: All 16 Frost tactics and native Cartesian product; freeze winners then four independent ABBA validation blocks (50 samples per call).
reference: FP64 dot products with FP32 activation, FP16 intermediate and expert outputs, ordered FP32 combine, BF16-rounded route scores for both paths. Relative L2 < 0.003 and normalized max < 0.01 for every timed candidate.
harness_note: Measured with the pre-integration CUPTI-only form of the checked-in benchmark; the checked-in script adds an explicit globaltimer option and expanded provenance. Device source hashes are below.
